content: क्रूर {%a.%} [कृत-रक् धातोः क्रूः; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Uṇ. 2. 21</ls>] .²1 Cruel, wicked, hard-hearted, pitiless; तस्याभिषेकसंभारं कल्पितं क्रूरनिश्चया <ls>R. 12. 4</ls>; <ls>Me. 107</ls>; <ls>Ms. 10. 9</ls>; तानहं द्विषतः क्रूरान् <ls>Bg. 16. 19</ls>. .²2 Hard, rough. .²3 Formidable, terrible, fierce, ferocious, savage. .²4 Destructive, mischievous. .²5 Wounded, hurt. .²6 Bloody. .²7 Raw. .²8 Strong. .²9 Inauspicious (as opposed to सौम्य and अक्रूर; said of 1st, 3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th and 11th signs of the zodiac which are supposed to have a malignant influence.) .²10 Hard, solid, hardened; <ls>Ś. 2. 4</ls>. .²11 Hot; disagreeable, sharp; <ls>Ms. 2. 33</ls>. .²12 Harsh; jarring; क्रूरक्वणत्कङ्कणानि <ls>Mv. 1. 35</ls>. .{@-रः, -रम्@} Boiled rice. .{@-रः@} .²1 A hawk. .²2 heron. .²3 An uneven sign of the zodiac. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of a planet (Rāhu or Saturn). .²5 A kind of horse; तद्वद्वामाश्रयः क्रूरः प्रकरोति धनक्षयम् <ls>Śālihotra 15</ls>. .{@-रम्@} .²1 A wound. .²2 Slaughter, cruelty. .²8 Any horrible deed. .²4 Any frightful appearance. --{%ind.%} In a formidable manner; <ls>Mb. 3</ls>.
